title: Three Hundred and Fifty Pounds of Freedom
summary: On Saturday, February 21, 2015, twelve days after open-heart CABG surgery, Jordan celebrates his first public outing with the family at The Smokin' Anvil in Christiansburg before taking delivery of his custom 350-pound matte-black Vanguard Titan-X350 motorized power wheelchair—and climbing the steep Geneva Street hill outside Bennett Hall completely under his own command.
